item.title: A Rainy Day in Tashkent
item.summary: Jasur has no umbrella on a rainy morning, but a kind woman at the bus stop helps him.
item.content_markdown:
It is Tuesday morning in Tashkent. Jasur looks out of the window. The sky is grey, and it is very cold. "It's fine," he thinks. "It never rains in October."

He takes his bag and goes to the bus stop. He doesn't have an umbrella. Then the rain starts. It rains and rains! Jasur's jacket is wet, and his shoes are wet too.

At the bus stop, there is a woman with a big red umbrella. She smiles at Jasur. "Come here," she says. "My umbrella is very big." They stand under the umbrella together and talk about the weather.

The bus comes, and Jasur says, "Thank you very much!" Now he always has an umbrella in his bag.

options: A woman helps Jasur on a rainy day.
Jasur loses his bag on the bus.
